services_intro: Airport arrivals, a chauffeur by the hour or a day beyond London. Choose the service that suits your plans.
experience_body: Comfort, punctuality and discretion guide every journey. Our professional chauffeurs know London and the United Kingdom, and each arrangement is shaped around your requirements.
fleet_intro: Executive and luxury saloons for smaller parties, and spacious vehicles for families and groups.
places_intro: Private tours shaped around your interests and the time you have. Discover the capital, or travel beyond it.
airport_title: An arrival to look forward to.
airport_intro: Private transfers to and from London’s six airports and major private aviation terminals.
cta_body: A private transfer, a day with your chauffeur or a journey beyond London. Tell us what you have in mind.
footer_description: Private transfers, chauffeur services and personalised tours in London and throughout the United Kingdom.

privacy_email_hint: Use the email address used for your enquiry. We will send a verification link. This form does not confirm whether we hold any records for that address.
privacy_received: Your request has been received. Please check your email for a verification link. You can also contact info@londratransfers.co.uk.
privacy_verified: Your email address has been verified. Our team will review your request and contact you about the outcome.
privacy_expired: This verification link is no longer available. Please submit a new request or contact us directly.
privacy_verify_intro: Confirm that you control this email address so that we can review your deletion request.
privacy_email_alternative: To request deletion or exercise another privacy right, please email info@londratransfers.co.uk.
privacy_email_verify: We received a request to delete information associated with this email address. Please open the link below and confirm your email address within 48 hours. An administrator will then review the request. If you did not make this request, you can ignore this message.
privacy_email_admin: A verified data deletion request is awaiting administrator review. Open the protected administration record to review its deadline, identity and any lawful retention requirements.
privacy_email_complete: We have completed the review and erased the eligible website enquiry records covered by your request. Relevant mailbox and export copies have been reviewed. Any remaining backup copies are kept out of normal use and expire under the recorded backup schedule. A limited administrative record of the outcome is retained without your contact details.
privacy_email_decision: We have reviewed your request. The reason for retaining the relevant information is set out below.
privacy_decision_rights: You may ask us to reconsider or make a complaint to the UK Information Commissioner’s Office or the relevant European supervisory authority. Contact: info@londratransfers.co.uk.
privacy_try_again: We could not submit your data deletion request. Please check the email address and try again.
privacy_form_expired: This request form has expired. Reload this page before submitting your request.

planning_note: Share your itinerary, the number of guests and any luggage or accessibility requirements. Our team will talk the arrangements through with you.
related_vehicles: Explore the rest of the fleet.
fleet_notes: E-Class and S-Class welcome up to 3 guests, V-Class up to 7 and Vito up to 8. Discuss luggage and individual requirements with our team.

process_detail_3: The service details and fare are agreed directly with our team before your journey is confirmed.
